script: Why did my future mother-in-law hand the DJ a USB drive twenty minutes before my wedding? But she didn't know who the DJ was. Because I had hired my own brother to run the booth. He opened the folder while she was still walking away. Forty-one photos of my fiancé with his ex, in a slideshow she had titled Remember Her. She had queued it for the first dance. My brother never told me. He walked that laptop straight to the groom's suite and set it on the table, still open. I don't know what my fiancé said to his mother. I only know she watched the ceremony from the back row, and the seat with her name on it stayed empty through dinner. Nobody announced anything, and nobody had to. And the thing both our families still won't say out loud is the part I keep going back to.
